text:
jordan (PeopleOps): quick — drafting a one-paragraph onboarding card managers can paste. keep it tiny and actionable.
alex (Hiring Manager): must cover who to ping for access, day1 agenda, and a single week1 deliverable.
nina (Eng Lead): add mentor pairing (3x 1hr in week1) and repo access note. link to internal setup can go into the hire record.
it-ops: managers should send full name + shipping address + laptop choice 48h before start. example `/device-request @it device:macbook-pro reason:onboarding`.
jordan (PeopleOps): draft below (pasteable):
---
Preboard: manager confirms name + address + laptop to IT; add to #product and team channel; PeopleOps sends welcome + 1:1 stub.
Day1 (sample): 9:30 manager intro (30m); 10:15 team intros (30m); 11:15 IT/account check (15m); 1pm product context (45m); 3pm buddy pairing (60m).
Week1 focus: daily 30m check-ins first 3 days; 3 buddy pairings; finish a small onboarding task (doc or PR).
Manager quick actions: confirm device by Fri EOD; nominate buddy; set Top 3 onboarding goals; schedule weekly 1:1s + 30/60/90 checkpoints.
---
alex (Hiring Manager): perfect, i'll paste.
jordan (PeopleOps): i'll attach a calendar bundle to the hire record. it-ops — please stage device after alex confirms.
it-ops: will do.
